Coca-Cola climbed 5.8% after its revenue rose 7% despite what CEO Henrique Braun called “a dynamic consumer landscape.”  Sherwin-Williams rallied 7%, and Illinois Tool Works rose 3.7% after both also reported stronger profits for the latest quarter than analysts expected.
